requiredChecks.rule: fixture origin, schemaVersion, batchId, candidateId, executionTrack, syntheticOnly, and fixtureSha256 must match this eligibility file
resetRef must exist, resetSha256 must match, deterministic must be true, and reset postconditions must be satisfied
actor must be able to confirm record access, identity proof use, and representative authority before access or application
requester category token and authority document tokens must be present for the selected branch
genericSyntheticRegistry must be able to return required readbackContract fields for the selected branch
attempt must use only synthetic registry state and synthetic authority tokens

ineligibleWhen: any required check is missing, unknown, false, or not evaluated
fixture or reset hash does not match current bytes
confirmation is absent before record access, application, or safe handoff
requester category or representative authority is unsupported by synthetic inputs
readbackContract fields cannot be returned by the synthetic registry
any live institution, live service, real personal data, or non-synthetic payload is requested

eligibleResult.requiredNextAction: run fixture branch only after reset postconditions and confirmation gate pass

ineligibleResult.requiredNextAction: stop attempt and report failed check without opening live records, querying live systems, or claiming completion
